journey.name: rbf replacement keeps the boosted fee rate
journey.description: Requires an English dev app with a disposable native wallet holding at least 100 000 confirmed Savings sats, and a regtest recipient address belonging to another wallet. Use the regtest backend in journeys/README.md and do not mine until the confirmation step below. This is an outgoing RBF boost, not incoming CPFP or a watch-only hardware payment. The recommended Boost rate is at least the Fast tier, so its replacement should show that tier's confirmation estimate, not the 1 sat/vB fallback. Ported from the matching iOS journey; Android dev uses staging regtest, while iOS E2E_BUILD uses its configured regtest backend. Both platforms keep the recommended fee when opening the pencil and use plus/minus controls for custom Boost edits. Recipient text can be pasted manually; agent runs must not type long addresses with adb input text.

actions.action: On Home, tap Send (id "Send"), dismiss any camera permission dialog with Don't Allow, and tap Enter Manually (id "RecipientManual")
Enter the regtest recipient in id "RecipientInput" and tap Continue (id "AddressContinue")
Choose Savings as the source, enter 10 000 sats with the number pad, and tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount")
On the review screen (id "SendConfirm"), open Fee & Speed, choose Custom, use the number pad to enter 1 sat/vB, and return to review with Continue
Swipe the send control (id "GRAB"), approve any fee warning and PIN prompt, wait for Sent (id "SendSuccess"), and tap Close (id "Close")
Open the unconfirmed sent transaction from Activity, note its transaction ID and total fee (id "ActivityFee"), and tap Boost (id "BoostButton")
Wait for the RBF Boost sheet (id "RBFBoost") to load its recommended Fast fee, open the pencil (id "CustomFeeButton"), and note the selected sat/vB rate and confirmation estimate
Swipe the Boost control (id "GRAB") and wait for success (id "BoostSuccessToast") without mining a block
Return to Activity and wait for the replacement transaction to appear; verify its row shows the Fast confirmation estimate from the Boost sheet
Open that row and verify it has a different transaction ID and a higher total fee (id "ActivityFee") than the original
Background and reopen Bitkit, unlock if needed, wait for sync, and verify the replacement's Activity row still shows the Fast estimate
Mine one regtest block, wait for sync, reopen the replacement transaction, and verify it is confirmed with the same higher total fee
